title: An approach to the Lindelöf Hypothesis for Dirichlet $L$-functions
summary: The suggested approach is based on a known representation of Dirichlet $L$-functions via the incomplete gamma functions. Some properties of the Taylor coefficients of the lower incomplete gamma function at infinity seem to be new. Specifically, these coefficients can be expressed in terms of Touchard polynomials. Furthermore, these same coefficients can be used to reformulate the functional equation for Dirichlet $L$-functions. This relationship "explains"' why $\vert L_χ(1/2+i t)\vert $ should be small.
